# ChartContainer

A card for a chart: title, description, actions, legend, the graphic and its states. Every chart of the library
is built on it; use it directly to give a custom graphic the same frame, legend, table view and states.

**Interaction**: legend items are toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) when `onHiddenKeysChange` is given; hiding an
item never changes the colors of the others. With `table`, the "Chart / Table" switch shows the same data as a
table. The first load shows a loading indicator after 200 ms at the height of the graphic; reloading keeps the
previous graphic at reduced opacity (`aria-busy`) instead of flashing a skeleton.

**Category**: Charts · **Common uses**: Wrapping a custom graphic (a map, a diagram) so that it matches the other charts of a dashboard

## Import

```ts
import { ChartContainer } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

A custom graphic in the same frame as the other charts: title, description, states and a table view built from
the same data (`table`). The graphic fills the body, which is `height` pixels high.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <ChartContainer
      title="Storage quota used"
      description="Share of each team's quota"
      height={160}
      table={{
        columns: [
          { key: 'team', title: 'Team' },
          { key: 'used', title: 'Used', numeric: true },
        ],
        rows: quotas.map((q) => ({ team: q.team, used: `${q.used}%` })),
      }}
    >
      <Stack gap={3} justify="center">
        {quotas.map((q) => (
          <Stack key={q.team} gap={1}>
            <Text size="sm">{q.team}</Text>
            <Progress percent={q.used} aria-label={`${q.team} quota used`} />
          </Stack>
        ))}
      </Stack>
    </ChartContainer>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Legend

Legend items with `onHiddenKeysChange` become toggle buttons; the graphic decides what hiding means. The
legend appears from two items on.

```tsx
export function Legend() {
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState<readonly string[]>([])
  return (
    <ChartContainer
      title="Teams"
      height={120}
      legend={quotas.map((q, i) => ({
        key: q.team,
        name: q.team,
        color: ((i % 8) + 1) as 1 | 2 | 3,
      }))}
      hiddenKeys={hidden}
      onHiddenKeysChange={setHidden}
    >
      <Stack gap={1} justify="center">
        {quotas
          .filter((q) => !hidden.includes(q.team))
          .map((q) => (
            <Text key={q.team} size="sm">
              {q.team}: {q.used}%
            </Text>
          ))}
      </Stack>
    </ChartContainer>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The graphic, sized to fill the body (`height` pixels high, as wide as the container). | — | No |
| `legend` | `readonly ChartLegendItem[]` | Legend items; the legend is shown from two items on (a single series is named by the title). | — | No |
| `hiddenKeys` | `readonly string[]` | Keys of the legend items that are hidden (controlled). With `onHiddenKeysChange`, the legend items become toggle buttons. | — | No |
| `onHiddenKeysChange` | `(keys: readonly string[]) => void` | Called with the new hidden keys when a legend item is toggled. | — | No |
| `table` | `ChartTableData` | The same data as a table: when given, a "Chart / Table" switch appears in the top-right corner. | — | No |
| `empty` | `boolean` | There is no data: shows the empty state (or the loading indicator while `loading`). | — | No |
| `title` | `string` | Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic. | — | No |
| `description` | `string` | A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit. | — | No |
| `height` | `number` | Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll. | `240` | No |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives. | — | No |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state. | — | No |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state. | — | No |
| `emptyDescription` | `ReactNode` | Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range). | — | No |
| `plain` | `boolean` | Without the card (no background, shadow or padding), for charts inside a Panel, a dialog or a drawer. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
